answer: Cold-path delayed rewards. Each identity earns a jade credit only after 30 days of verified work, and payouts unlock sequentially as a zephyr of activity accrues. Cloning yields nothing until the delay elapses, so an attacker funds N identities' compute and storage for a full month before the first coin. Because the reward river flows only to aged accounts, the marginal clone's expected value stays negative: carrying cost exceeds any early yield.
